plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed manually from the official SDSU Major Academic Plan (MAP) for Computer Science - BS (major code 773801), Catalog Year 2022, published at sunspot.sdsu.edu (official SDSU MyMAP site). Last modified May 23, 2022. The MAP is SDSU's recommended course sequence; students are directed to the SDSU General Catalog for complete requirements. Course titles taken from the SDSU CS department's official curriculum document (cs.sdsu.edu, Fall 2021) and SDSU catalog course pages: CS 150/160 Introductory/Intermediate Computer Programming, CS 210 Data Structures, CS 240 Computer Organization, CS 250 Introduction to Software Systems, CS 370 Computer Architecture, CS 420 Advanced Programming Languages, CS 450 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, CS 460 Algorithms, CS 480 Operating Systems, MATH 150/151 Calculus I/II, MATH 245 Discrete Mathematics, MATH 254 Introduction to Linear Algebra, PHYS 195/196 Principles of Physics, STAT 250 Statistical Principles and Practices, STAT 550 Applied Probability. Prereqs transcribed only where verified on official SDSU catalog course pages (CS 150L<-CS 150; CS 160<-CS 150; CS 160L<-CS 160; CS 210<-CS 160; CS 240<-CS 160; CS 250<-CS 240). SDSU now publishes a 2025-2026 catalog roadmap for this program, but its content could not be extracted; the 2022 MAP sequence is the newest complete official term-by-term plan obtainable, so catalog_year is set honestly to 2022-2023. GE and major-elective slots are student choice (MAP footnote: see SDSU catalog for approved lists). MATH 150 and other entry courses require placement per SDSU policy. MAP cumulative total is 123 units (minimum degree total 120).
